lines: You've learned the whole system. Now let's talk about climbing — ranking up and earning more.
Every rank has a target: your own personal volume, plus your team's group volume.
Hit both, and you promote — unlocking deeper levels of override income on your team.
The higher your rank, the more levels of your organization you get paid on.
Each new rank also pays a one-time bonus, a reward for the milestone you reached.
On the insurance side, staying productive can trigger extra weekly and team bonuses too.
One simple habit drives it all: a little personal production every single month.
Consistency is the whole game. Small steps, repeated, become big ranks over time.
You now have the full roadmap — from day one, to your first sale, to leading a team.
So take that first step, and keep climbing. Welcome to Apex — we'll see you at the top.
